draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 48th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 10th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 84, well after his grade rank (48th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Marvin Mims Jr.. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (88th percentile). College production: 789 receiving yards in 2023, 23rd of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 14 career games and 4 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 166 receiving yards against a median of 290, below the norm.
